youtube_short.title: Last Year's #1 Fund Is a Trap
title_alternatives: The 5-Star Fund Trap Nobody Warns You About
Why Chasing Top Funds Costs You $285,000
youtube_short.description: 86% of top-rated funds drop out of the top tier within 3 years — yet most people keep chasing last year's winner. That 1.7% annual drag from fund-hopping adds up to a $285,000 gap over 30 years on just $100K invested. When you buy the top-rated fund, the institutional money that drove those returns is already selling. The boring index fund in the middle? That's your actual play. Follow for more money truths that don't make the headlines. #investing #indexfunds #personalfinance #mutualfunds #wealthbuilding
